name: save-your-memory
description: Index an env-configured Windows file tree into a persistent Markdown wiki and answer questions with source-linked evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Turn local files into a searchable, source-linked wiki.
interface.longDescription: Recursively indexes a Windows directory from .env, extracts readable file content into a persistent Markdown wiki, and retrieves evidence so Codex can answer where information lives and what it says.
defaultPrompt: Find this information in my memory wiki.
Check my memory wiki for inconsistencies.
